difficultyLevels.title: Opening wounds
difficultyLevels.description: Heroes take 10% Max HP damage at the start of each combat.

difficultyLevels.title: Reduced income
difficultyLevels.description: Earn 1 fewer Shard per surviving Hero at the end of each combat.

difficultyLevels.title: Restricted equipment
difficultyLevels.description: Heroes can only equip 1 item per rank.

difficultyLevels.title: Boss influence
difficultyLevels.description: Act Bosses influence combats in their act, making them more difficult.

difficultyLevels.title: Six-challenge contract
difficultyLevels.description: Complete all 6 challenges and defeat the final boss. A failed challenge ends the run and resets the win streak; enemies have increased stats and the run cannot continue into Endless Mode.

masteryLevels.title: Tilly Bundle
masteryLevels.description: Unlock Tilly, a Duelist / Warrior who generates Shards through rapid attacks.

masteryLevels.title: Rush / Stall Bundle
masteryLevels.description: Unlock a starting bundle of items and relics built for Rush and Stall teams.

masteryLevels.title: Boss Token
masteryLevels.description: Unlock the first Boss Token slot and starting-bundle rerolls.

masteryLevels.title: Zuri Bundle
masteryLevels.description: Unlock Zuri, an Assassin / Tank who permanently gains stats by landing Crits.

masteryLevels.title: Shield Bundle
masteryLevels.description: Unlock a starting bundle of items and relics built around Shields.

masteryLevels.title: Second Boss Token
masteryLevels.description: Unlock a second Boss Token slot.

masteryLevels.title: Niklas Bundle
masteryLevels.description: Unlock Niklas, a Vanguard who consumes items to permanently gain their stats.

masteryLevels.title: Debuff Bundle
masteryLevels.description: Unlock a starting bundle of items and relics built around Debuffs.

masteryLevels.title: Two Boss Tokens
masteryLevels.description: Unlock the third and fourth Boss Token slots.

stats.name: Max HP
stats.description: A character dies when their Health reaches 0.
stats.practical: Compare effective durability with Defense and Shields, not Max HP alone.

stats.name: Max Mana
stats.description: Characters cast their active ability whenever their Max Mana becomes full.
stats.practical: Starting Mana and Mana Regen determine time to the first and later casts.

stats.name: Mana Regen
stats.description: The amount of Mana a character gains every 2 seconds.
stats.practical: Treat it as a two-second pulse rather than a continuous per-second gain.

stats.name: Defense
stats.description: Reduces incoming damage. 100 Defense means 1/2 damage received, 200 means 1/3, and 300 means 1/4.
stats.practical: Each additional 100 Defense adds another part to the divisor: damage received is scaled by 100 / (100 + Defense).

stats.name: Move Speed
stats.description: The speed a character moves from hex to hex during combat.
stats.practical: Movement time can delay first contact even when the target is technically in reach.

stats.name: Base Attack Damage
stats.description: The amount of damage a character deals with auto attacks. Increased by Attack.
stats.practical: Use it as the starting value before Attack scaling and other effects.

stats.name: Attack
stats.description: Increases the damage of auto attacks.
stats.practical: Warriors also use Attack to scale many active abilities.

stats.name: Magic
stats.practical: Read each ability to see whether Magic increases damage, Shields, healing, or another effect.

stats.name: Attack Range
stats.description: The distance in hexes that a character can auto attack from.
stats.practical: Range is measured on the hex board; visual distance alone can be misleading.

stats.name: Base Attack Speed
stats.description: The number of times a character auto attacks per second. Increased by Attack Speed.
stats.practical: Trigger-heavy Duelist and Crit builds care about attack frequency as much as hit size.

stats.name: Attack Speed
stats.description: Increases how often a character auto attacks.
stats.practical: Evaluate it through attacks per second and the triggers each extra attack creates.

stats.name: Crit
stats.description: The percent chance that an auto attack or active ability deals double damage. Each Crit above 100 increases Crit Damage by 1%.
stats.practical: Crit above 100 is not wasted; it moves from chance into higher critical damage.

stats.name: Omnivamp
stats.description: Restores Health based on damage dealt. 1 Omnivamp equals 1% healing from damage dealt.
stats.practical: It is strongest on heroes that deal reliable damage and survive long enough to convert it into healing.

stats.name: HP Per Second
stats.description: Characters restore Health equal to their HP/S each second.
stats.practical: Sustained recovery needs time; it does not replace protection from opening burst damage.

stats.name: Starting Mana
stats.description: The amount of Mana a character begins combat with.
stats.practical: Use it to move a decisive first cast ahead of an enemy ability or frontline collapse.

classes.name: Warrior
classes.summary: Uses Attack to deal damage with auto attacks and active abilities.

classes.name: Tank
classes.summary: Uses Defense to protect allies and disrupt enemies.

classes.name: Vanguard
classes.summary: Uses Max HP to absorb and deal damage.

classes.name: Assassin
classes.summary: Uses Crit for bursts of damage from auto attacks and active abilities.

classes.name: Duelist
classes.summary: Uses Attack Speed to rapidly auto attack.

classes.name: Mystic
classes.summary: Uses Mana Regen to repeatedly cast, aid allies, and disrupt enemies.

classes.name: Mage
classes.summary: Uses Magic to deal damage and disrupt enemies with active abilities.

guilds.name: The Hunt
guilds.tagline: When the call comes, we hunt.
guilds.description: A guild of Awakened professionals built for the chase: first through the door and closing in before a rift can breach and do real damage. They hunt for the monster, the trophy, and the reputation that follows.

guilds.name: Frontline
guilds.description: Frontline believes the only way to close the rifts is to overpower them. Its teams train and compete like athletes, chasing a personal best with every break.

guilds.name: Gaia Project
guilds.tagline: Fight for tomorrow, not just today.
guilds.description: A community-driven guild that treats rifts as living phenomena to be understood. Its Breakers study each one and work to restore the natural balance around it.

guilds.name: A Temple
guilds.description: A Temple believes the Shards and relics inside rifts belong to everyone, not only whoever can buy the extraction rights. They fight to put those treasures in ordinary hands.

guilds.name: L'Héritage
guilds.description: A prestige guild for old-money heirs and rising stars. It trains elite, media-ready Breakers and moves easily through circles where wealth, fame, and power overlap.

guilds.name: Aegis Global
guilds.description: A corporate guild with a global network spanning crystal refinement, relic acquisition, and rift forecasting. Its contracts keep supply chains moving and rift activity contained.

shopSystems.name: Freeze
shopSystems.description: Keep a regular Shop's offers until the next visit.

shopSystems.name: Auction House
shopSystems.description: After a Boss, browse more and higher-rarity offers. It cannot be frozen.

shopSystems.name: Rift Key
shopSystems.description: Assemble the Rift Key from Shop fragments; the fragment cost increases at each Shop.

shopSystems.name: Scaling Indicator
shopSystems.description: Shows which abilities scale with the stats on an item before you commit the purchase.
